pg006_n0005: This Learn English textbook has been prepared based on the 2023 Primary Education Syllabus, Standard I–II, prepared by the Ministry of Education, Science and Technology.
pg006_n0006: It is a revised edition of Reading Standard One Pupil’s Book One that was published in 2019 in accordance with the 2016 Basic Education Syllabus for Standard I issued by the Ministry of Education, Science and Technology.
pg006_n0008: The book aims to enable the child to develop competences in listening, speaking and reading by performing different learning activities through the following: imitating different sounds, relating words to familiar objects in the environment, following simple instructions given at school and home, naming parts of the body orally, pronouncing English letter sounds, recognising English sounds in various spoken words, identifying words with the same initial sounds and words with the same final sounds, combining letter sounds to form words, associating letter names to sounds, recognising numbers and talking about times of the day, introducing oneself and others, using common greetings and polite expressions, and saying goodbye to others.

pg006_n0008_easy_read:
This book helps the child develop skills in:
- listening
- speaking
- reading

The child develops these skills through learning activities such as:
- imitating different sounds
- matching words with familiar objects in the environment
- following simple instructions at school and at home
- naming parts of the body by speaking
- pronouncing English letter sounds
- recognising English sounds in different spoken words
- identifying words with the same first sounds and words with the same final sounds
- joining letter sounds to make words
- matching letter names with sounds
- recognising numbers and talking about times of the day
- introducing oneself and other people
- using common greetings and polite expressions
- saying goodbye to other people
